title: $\bf{S^1}$-index theory for the Lorentz force equation
summary: In this paper we prove that the $S^1$-invariance of the Poincaré action functional associated to the Lorentz force equation gives the existence of multiple critical points which are periodic solutions with a fixed period. To do this, we prove an abstract multiplicity result which is based upon the Lusternik-Schnirelman method with the $S^1$-index. The corresponding result in the context of the Fadell-Rabinowitz index is proved in Ekeland and Lasry (Ann. Math., 112 (1980)).
